description: Defines the LeavePeriod class which represents a period with start and end dates related to leave management in the HR system. It includes methods for setting and getting the dates, as well as formatting them to a YMD string.

classes.name: LeavePeriod
classes.description: Represents a leave period with start and end dates, providing getters, setters, and formatting functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeavePeriod object with optional start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getYmdStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date formatted as a YMD string.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a YMD string.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.
